prompt: Write a complete Arduino sketch (sketch.ino) for an ESP32 DevKit (Arduino-ESP32 core 3.0.7). Fade the LED on GPIO 4 up and down continuously with hardware PWM: 5 kHz, 8-bit resolution, using the core 3.x LEDC API (ledcAttach and ledcWrite by pin). Step the duty cycle with millis() every 10 ms; never call delay(). Use only the core; no libraries.
